Force all bindings in an environment

Source: R/utils.R
force_promises.Rd

Evaluates every binding in env so that unforced argument promises (created by lazy evaluation) are replaced by their values. This prevents env from keeping its calling frame alive when it is referenced by a returned object (e.g. a ggplot's plot_env) and later serialized (e.g. by saveRDS()), which would otherwise pull the caller's data into the serialized object.

Usage

force_promises(env = parent.frame())

Arguments

env

The environment whose bindings to force. Default: the caller's frame.

Value

Invisibly NULL.
